recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit as-is. Future Pharmacy/Terminology work such as FHIR-53306, FHIR-36027, or UP-555 can redesign or move these example code systems, but the current core source should not continue to publish discharge as an exemplar location category after FHIR-25555.
issue_request: FHIR-25555 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 Pharmacy category attributes. It requested broader category examples, removal of discharge from the exemplar value set, and an updated category-oriented exemplar value set name.
initial_application: The 2020 FHIR-25555 commits partially applied the request: 356f7ed created administration-location code systems without discharge, while 68b064d renamed MedicationRequest to category but still included discharge. Later refactors and FHIR-51726 moved/reintroduced the category CodeSystems in core, leaving discharge in current active source.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, MedicationRequest, and MedicationStatement as active resources. Current source already uses category-named ValueSets and retains broader category prose where later source decisions still permit it. FHIR-53306 later removed some broader examples and added terminology follow-up notes, so the safe reconciliation was limited to the lingering discharge concepts.
reconciliation: Deleted the discharge concept from source/medicationadministration/codesystem-medication-admin-category.xml, source/medicationdispense/codesystem-medicationdispense-category.xml, and source/medicationrequest/codesystem-medicationrequest-category.xml. Their ValueSets include the whole CodeSystem, so the example value sets now expand to inpatient, outpatient, and community only.

related_jiras.note: Moved the medication category CodeSystems back into FHIR core, making the lingering discharge concepts current-build source again.
Changed current category descriptions and terminology notes, explaining why this reconciliation did not restore all 2020 example prose.
Requested additional MedicationUsage/MedicationStatement category examples; its implementation path is separate from removing discharge for FHIR-25555.
Unresolved UTG proposal behind later THO/core discussion; not a final FHIR-core source decision for this reconciliation.
